trickyParts: The fork's main.ts installs the storage inside the existing session-resolution try so SessionStorageConfigError shares SessionResolutionError's stderr+exit(1) path (hint printed only for SessionResolutionError).

omp gc is on-disk maintenance (fs.readdir/rename/gzip of the sessions tree, blobs, WAL); its listing goes through defaultSessionStorage() for a single seam but the gc command does not resolve session.storage — docs/session.md says so explicitly.

Bun.SQL does not connect in the constructor; the CREATE TABLE in SqlSessionStorage.create is the first round trip, so an unreachable database rejects there with PostgresError ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_CLOSED 'Connection closed'; the resolver ends the client best-effort and wraps naming source+path, never the DSN.

The extension's process-local record lives on globalThis under Symbol.for('legion.pi-envoy.bootstrapped-session') because each task subagent's extension instance is a separate module instance; resetLegionBootstrappedSessionForTests() clears it in the suite's afterEach. The controller branch records getSessionFile() (isSubagentSession's ensureOnDisk already persisted it) so controller subagents are recognised under SQL too.
The pane's bash tool dropped twice ('Unable to connect') mid-phase; non-credentialed work ran via eval subprocesses, credentialed pushes waited for bash.

sessionStorageProbe.what: verifySessionStorageSetting(ompInvocation, ompLaunchPrefix, runner, options) in packages/daemon/src/daemon/boot-probes.ts; called third in cmdProbeImage (packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts) unconditionally; NOT wired into startDaemonLocked's launch hold (LEGION-81 does that under session_store: postgres). killedOutcome's negativeMarker became optional: this probe's negative answer is an exit code, not a marker, so a budget kill is always transient for it.
whyThisPath: It must exit 0 on an old build without a provider key, network, or TTY, and run the resolver first on a new one. Subcommands (omp models, omp gc) never reach runRootCommand, where the resolver lives. -p needs a model ('No models available', exit 1 without a key). --mode rpc reaches the same exit. --resume/--from-claude exit 0 only when the box has no sessions — box-state dependent. --version/--export exit before settings load.

PI_TIMING=x: an interactive start-up prints its timing tree and exits 0 right before the TUI opens (main.ts `if ($env.PI_TIMING) { logger.printTimings(); if (logger.shouldExitAfterTimings()) process.exit(0) }`, shouldExitAfterTimings = timingModeIncludes('x'|'full') in packages/utils/src/logger.ts). The resolver runs at the session-resolution block, before that exit. Stdin on /dev/null: readPipedInput returns undefined for empty non-TTY stdin, so autoPrint is false and the start is interactive (print mode would exit 1 'No models available'). --no-session keeps the probe out of the sessions directory; --no-extensions/--no-skills/--no-rules/--no-lsp/--no-tools keep the profile's plugins, servers, and tools out of a run that only needs the resolver.

Measured on this box with provider keys and LEGION_*/DISPATCH_* scrubbed: old pin 104423 → exit 0 in ~5 s (timing tree on stderr); feat/session-sql-storage source → exit 1 `Error: OMP_SESSION_STORAGE is "legion-launch-probe"; expected "file" or "sql"`.

Precondition: the build honours PI_TIMING=x. Every sami pin from 18.1.18-sami.20260912-104423 on does (measured on 104423). On a build that did not, the interactive start without a TTY would exit non-zero without naming the variable → transient → the exhausted message names the launch command.
No fork commit was needed: the branch as pushed (1fe988b7) already runs the resolver before this exit-0 path.
sessionStorageProbe.classification: exit != 0 and stderr contains 'OMP_SESSION_STORAGE' → pass; exit 0 → definitive ('… started with OMP_SESSION_STORAGE=legion-launch-probe (exit 0): this build predates the session.storage setting and would silently keep sessions on files under a sql session store; pin a fork release that carries the setting'); exit != 0 without the variable → transient (stderr tail as detail), retried per policy, 'never completed within its retry budget (N attempts) for launch command …' when exhausted; runner kill → killedOutcome (aborted → ProbeAbortedError; timedOut → transient).
sessionStorageProbe.tests: packages/daemon/src/daemon/__tests__/boot-probes.test.ts: pass (exact command incl. a launch prefix), exit-0 definitive with no retry, non-zero without the name retried 6× then exhausted with sleeps 10/20/40/80/160 s, budget kill transient. packages/daemon/src/cli/__tests__/index.test.ts: cmdProbeImage runs three probes (third command asserted), refuses an image whose OMP exits 0 on the nonsense value. `bun test packages/daemon/src/daemon/__tests__/boot-probes.test.ts packages/daemon/src/cli/__tests__/index.test.ts -t probe` → 13 pass; packages/daemon `bun run typecheck` exit 0; biome check clean.
